description: Pillar 1 regulated-software content + lead magnet (plan item 10): scheduled posts #1-#10 from the D5 table (GxP validation pillar, Part 11 audit trail, GAMP 5 Cat 4 vs 5, EU Annex 11, LIMS URS template, Custom vs off-the-shelf LIMS comparison, LIMS implementation checklist, NABL/ISO 15189 software requirements, PV E2B(R3), validation package), expansion of the existing Part 11 checklist post (and GAMP 5 guide if below the article rules), downloadable URS template CSV + /resources/lims-urs-template page with env-gated email capture. Depends on FEAT-001 (schedule, PostLink, pillars) and FEAT-002 (analytics trackEvent).
steps: For each of schedule #1-#10 create src/content/insights/<slug>.tsx (exact slugs and dates from the D5 table in .agents/tasks/seo-plan-impl.md, pillar 'regulated', #1 pillarHub true) following the article rules in D5: 1,500-2,500 words, 40-60 word direct answer first, >= 1 DataTable, >= 5 FAQs, 3-5 in-body internal links (PostLink for posts; services like /services/lims-software-development, /services/computer-system-validation, /services/pharmacovigilance-software, /academy/software-validation-gamp5-course), cta set, readingMinutes ~ words/220, metaTitle <= 60. Model the structure on src/content/insights/csv-vs-csa-computer-software-assurance.tsx and part-11-lims-checklist.tsx. State regulations accurately and generally (21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, GAMP 5 2nd ed., ICH E2B(R3), ISO 15189/NABL); no invented statistics; note that validation sign-off stays with the client QA. Register all in src/content/insights/index.ts.

Expand src/content/insights/part-11-lims-checklist.tsx (slug 21-cfr-part-11-compliance-checklist-lims) to the article rules; set updated to the real edit date; keep published. Check gamp-5-validation-guide.tsx against the rules via crawler words/table/FAQ and bring it up only if it fails (then set updated).
Create public/downloads/lims-urs-template.csv (columns: ID, Section, Requirement, Type (GxP/Business), Priority, Regulatory reference, Verification method, Notes; generic example rows only).

Create src/components/LeadCaptureForm.tsx (client; posts name/email/company to NEXT_PUBLIC_LEAD_FORM_ENDPOINT; validation, labels, aria-live status, consent line; trackEvent('generate_lead',{form:'urs_template'}); when env unset render only the download button) and src/app/resources/lims-urs-template/page.tsx (PageLayout, pageMetadata, breadcrumb, direct answer, what's inside, FAQ + faqJsonLd, download + form, PostLink to lims-urs-template article, revalidate 3600). Add the page to sitemap.ts, llms.txt and the footer Regulated column; link it from /services/lims-software-development.

Verify with a normal build (all 10 new posts 404 + hidden; resource page live) and a CONTENT_NOW=2026-12-31 build (all render, crawler clean, word counts in range); record word counts per post in findings.
acceptance_criteria: npm run lint and npm run build pass
Normal build: the 10 new slugs return 404 and are absent from /insights, /sitemap.xml, /llms.txt and related links; existing posts unaffected
CONTENT_NOW=2026-12-31 build: all 10 render, crawler 0 errors, no broken links, each new post 1,500-2,500 words in the crawler Words column, FAQ schema matches visible text
Pillar post links to every regulated cluster (published ones as links, unpublished as plain text in a normal build)
/resources/lims-urs-template returns 200, offers the CSV download (200 at /downloads/lims-urs-template.csv), and shows no email form when NEXT_PUBLIC_LEAD_FORM_ENDPOINT is unset
Part 11 checklist post has updated date set and meets the article rules; no invented statistics or claims
verification: npx next start -p 3100 (background) then node .kiro/skills/seo-audit/scripts/audit.mjs http://localhost:3100 --out .agents/seo-audit-2026-10-04.md

findings.claims_and_accuracy: No statistics, prices, client names or outcomes invented. Regulatory facts used and checked: 21 CFR 11.10(a)-(k), 11.30, 11.50, 11.70, 11.100 certification, 11.200, 11.300; FDA 2003 Scope and Application guidance; FDA 2018 data-integrity CGMP Q&A (audit-trail review before final approval); FDA CSA guidance final Sept 2025 (also corrected in the GAMP 5 guide, which said only 'draft 2022'); EU GMP Annex 11 in operation since 30 June 2011, 17 sections, section 9 reason for change, section 3 suppliers, 4.8 migration; draft revision of Annex 11 + Chapter 4 + new Annex 22 released for consultation July 2025 (web-checked; posts say to check status, 2011 text applies until a final version is adopted); revised Schedule M notified Dec 2023 aligned with WHO/PIC/S; GAMP 5 2nd ed 2022, categories 1/3/4/5, no Category 2; ICH E2B(R3) on ISO/HL7 ICSR, sections N/C/D/E/F/G/H, EudraVigilance mandatory since 30 June 2022 (web-checked on ema.europa.eu), other regions described generally; ISO 15189:2022 (incl. POCT), NABL as QCI constituent board, clause numbers deliberately not cited; DPDP Act 2023 interpretation left to legal advisers; MedDRA licence stays with the MAH. Every post states or implies that validation approval/release stays with the client's QA. Bright Infonet capability wording reuses existing site claims (PVgenix 'described on our work page', Software Validation course).

Then test once in a browser: errors, success message, download link, GA4 generate_lead with form=urs_template. gotchas: ISR caches 404s too: fetching a scheduled slug on a normal-build server writes a cached 404 into .next, so a later server with CONTENT_NOW still serves 404 for up to the revalidate window. For on-demand preview tests, rebuild first and don't request the slug beforehand; rebuild normally afterwards.

The crawler Words column counts all of <main> (TOC, PillarNav list, related cards, CTA), roughly 400-500 words more than the article itself on regulated posts in the CONTENT_NOW build; aim article bodies at ~1,500-1,800 so the crawler number stays under 2,500.
Rendered <title>/meta lengths in raw HTML are inflated by entities (&); measure lengths from the source strings.
